items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And Marian was part of the trio of Coleman Hawkins.

ctx.x: very bad. So I called up the guy at the Embers. I can't think of his name now, right now and told him you know, audition Marian, she's ready, with the trio, she'll do great.

And so she got the job, at the Embers. And she was there, as a matter of fact I think it was Coleman Hawkins, they had a quartet. And Marian was part of the trio of Coleman Hawkins. And she started going and she's had her trio ever since. But we really.......
Well that's how it happened then, ahah?
